verdict.rationale: Beamer documents a built-in AI capability for one task: generating changelog posts. That is a narrow form of delegating work to in-product AI, not a general assistant that takes on varied tasks. The evidence is a single marketing line. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant, delegation of tasks beyond post drafting (e.g., segmentation, analytics, feedback triage), documentation of how the assistant works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create clear, on-brand changelog posts in seconds with AI.
